headline: Anthropic expands abroad while Gartner predicts agent pullback
body: Several small stories, none large. Anthropic opened a Milan office and named a head for Korea, adding to Power Concentration, which lifts Enslaved God and lowers Libertarian Utopia. Gartner predicted 40% of organisations will scale back AI agents over governance problems, a small brake on AI Autonomy that trims Descendants. The same concentration of power also nudges up 1984. Courts in China and Russia moved to set rules for AI cases, and Indian celebrities sought protection from deepfakes. Senator Elizabeth Warren called for taxing AI firms. Horizon Balance is 0.4, down 0.07.
movers_note: Enslaved God +0.2 and Libertarian Utopia -0.2, mostly from Anthropic's expansion (+0.18/-0.18); 1984 +0.2, mostly from the Anthropic expansion (+0.12) with small court stories adding +0.02 each.
